records.title: Realizing Native INT8 Compute for Diffusion Transformers on Consumer GPUs: A Fused INT8 GEMM Kernel for Ideogram 4.0
records.reason: Full-text read for Research: the target is the image-generation diffusion transformer Ideogram 4.0 (9.3B), fusing a fake-quantization path into a native INT8 GEMM kernel on consumer Ampere GPUs (GEMM 2.8-4.2x, 1024px generation 156.5s). The kernel technique is adjacent to LLM inference quantization, but the paper itself targets image diffusion models, not LLM inference systems, so immediate Research grounding is weak.
records.body_check: research_fulltext_relevance_review: read arXiv HTML full text; all evaluation is Ideogram 4.0 image generation on consumer GPUs; no LLM inference evaluation
